updateNote.en: This edition explains what each observation buys and distinguishes reconstruction error, state identification and fact retrieval.
updateNote.zh: 本版说明每次观测提供的信息，并区分向量重建、名录版本识别与事实检索。

en.title: Which edits reveal the embedding of an unseen directory?
en.summary: Three edits can overlap in pairs even when no single city is shared by all three. Two designs each encode 23 of 64 possible directories. On 2,048 synthetic worlds written as individual facts, observing triples that share a city reduces reconstruction error by 53.4% for BGE and 36.0% for E5 relative to observing a cycle. Better reconstruction does not consistently improve fact retrieval.

zh.title: 观察哪些改动，才能还原未见名录的嵌入？
zh.summary: 三次改动可以两两涉及同一座城市，却找不到一座被三次共同涉及的城市。两套方案都直接编码 64 种名录中的 23 种。在 2,048 个以单句陈述事实的合成世界中，与环状重叠方案相比，观测三次改动共享同一座城市的组合，使 BGE 和 E5 的重建误差分别相对降低 53.4% 和 36.0%。事实检索的变化还取决于所问的问题。

title.en: When three swaps draw the same triangle
title.zh: 相同的三角形可以代表两种换法

en: Swap Dublin with Accra in the residence field, Dublin with Seoul in the work field and Dublin with Athens in the study field. All three swaps touch Dublin. Now replace only the last swap with Accra–Seoul. Every pair of swaps still touches a common city, but each pair meets at a different one. A diagram with one edge per overlapping pair shows the same triangle in both cases.
zh: 把居住地字段中的都柏林与阿克拉对换，工作地字段中的都柏林与首尔对换，学习地字段中的都柏林与雅典对换。三次交换都涉及都柏林。现在只改最后一次，换成阿克拉与首尔。三次交换仍然两两有交集，但每一对相交在不同的城市。若只给相交的交换连一条边，两种情形画出来都是三角形。

caption.en: Figure 1. In the star, one city belongs to all three swaps. In the cycle, each pair of swaps shares a different city. Counting the pairs that overlap gives the same answer in both panels.
caption.zh: 图 1。星形方案里有一座城市贯穿三次交换。环形方案里，每一对交换共享的城市都不同。两图中相交的交换对数相同。

alt.en: City swaps sharing one value compared with a cycle of pairwise-shared cities.
alt.zh: 三条边共享一座城市与每两条边共享不同城市的对照。

title.zh: 同样观测 23 次，该观测哪些版本？

en: Six binary edits define 64 versions of each four-person directory. Star23 and Cycle23 encode 23 states each and use the same quadratic reconstruction rule for the remaining states. The experiment varies which joint edits are observed while keeping the number of observations, target states and decoder fixed. Two renderings express the same facts as atomic sentences or compressed prose.

BGE-small and E5-small encode 2,048 synthetic test worlds. Three measures answer different questions. Normalized mean squared error measures distance to the true embedding. R22 asks whether the reconstruction identifies the correct directory among 22 candidates. Balanced query ranking asks whether a user seeking a fact retrieves the right record.
zh: 四人名录上的六个二元编辑产生 64 个状态。Star23 和 Cycle23 各编码 23 个状态，均用同一二次重建规则推算其他状态。实验改变联合观测的选择，同时固定观测数、目标状态和解码器。两种文本形式分别以原子句和压缩语句表述同一组事实。
BGE-small 和 E5-small 各编码 2,048 个合成测试世界。三种指标分别回答三个问题。归一化均方误差衡量重建向量与真实向量的距离。R22 检查能否从 22 个候选中认出正确的名录版本。均衡查询排序则检查，按一项事实搜索时，相关记录排在什么位置。

title.en: A shared city improves reconstruction for both encoders
title.zh: 两种编码器都能利用共同城市改善重建

en: Across both text formats and both encoders, Star23 gives lower normalized reconstruction error than Cycle23. On records written as individual sentences, the relative reductions are 53.4% for BGE and 36.0% for E5. On compressed records the probability of identifying the exact state rises by 15.45 and 15.80 percentage points, respectively. In a separate atomic-text check on 512 preselected worlds from the same pool, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B shows a 6.58% relative error reduction.
zh: 在两种文本格式和两种编码器上，Star23 的归一化重建误差都低于 Cycle23。把每项事实写成单句时，BGE 和 E5 的误差分别相对降低 53.4% 和 36.0%。把记录压缩成短文时，两者辨认正确版本的成功率分别提高 15.45 和 15.80 个百分点。在同一世界池预选的 512 个世界上，Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B 的单句文本重建误差相对降低 6.58%。

caption.en: For each encoder and rendering, the left value is Star23 and the right value is Cycle23. Lower normalized mean squared error (NMSE) indicates closer reconstruction. Higher R22 means more correct identifications among 22 candidate states. Manuscript Table 1.
caption.zh: 每个单元格依次列出 Star23 与 Cycle23。归一化均方误差（NMSE）越低，重建越接近真实嵌入。R22 越高，从 22 个候选中认出正确版本的比例越大。见原稿表 1。

title.en: Recovering the directory and finding a fact are different tasks
title.zh: 认出名录版本与查到其中一项事实

en: On BGE embeddings of atomic text, nDCG@5 rises by 0.12424 percentage points for same-entity queries and falls by 0.03569 points for different-entity queries. On compressed E5 text, the shared-city design identifies the right directory 15.80 points more often, yet balanced query nDCG@5 falls by 0.03542 percentage points. An index chosen for state identification therefore still needs evaluation on the queries it will serve.

The 23-state design, four-person directories and fixed checkpoints define this evidence. The Qwen comparison reuses a subset of the same world pool. Natural documents, larger edit systems and additional independent pools would test how far the shared-value pattern extends.
zh: 对于 BGE 的单句文本嵌入，同实体查询的 nDCG@5 提高 0.12424 个百分点，跨实体查询下降 0.03569 个百分点。对 E5 的压缩文本，共同城市方案辨认正确名录的成功率提高了 15.80 个百分点，均衡查询的 nDCG@5 却下降了 0.03542 个百分点。即使按版本识别效果选好了索引，也还需要用实际要处理的查询检验它。
证据来自固定检查点、四人名录和特定的 23 状态方案。Qwen 比较沿用了原测试池的子集。自然文档、更大的编辑空间及独立世界池将检验这一规律的外推范围。

title.en: Recalculate the paired differences by world
title.zh: 以世界为单位复算配对差值

en: The CPU replay reads the released scalar measurements and averages the six conditions within each world before comparing designs. It verifies the eight primary contrasts and reconstructs the paired interval for 512 Qwen worlds using the original 10,000 bootstrap draws. The archive supplies the synthetic inputs, observation designs, calibration choices and saved rankings. Encoding new text requires the corresponding encoder.
Using the original inference code and shared bootstrap draws, the 2,048 paired worlds also reproduce all eight simultaneous 95% intervals. The family-wise critical value is 2.70526.
zh: CPU 回放读取公开的标量测量，在每个世界内先平均六个条件，再比较两种方案。它核对八项主要对照，并用原来的 10,000 次自助抽样重建 512 个 Qwen 世界的配对区间。归档提供合成输入、观测方案、校准选择和排序记录。为新文本计算嵌入时需要相应的编码器。
用原统计实现对 2,048 个配对世界做同一组自助抽样，可以恢复全部八项同时 95% 区间；整组的临界值为 2.70526。
